pages.text: The Celestial Distributor is a zero-buffer capability proxy. Starting at adjacent blocks, it follows containers whose contacting face is valid and inherits that access face, selecting up to 16 targets by default. Air, ordinary blocks, and capability-free blocks stop the search. Distributors never chain. Servers may enable [distributor].searchAllSides to scan every container face.

Incoming items, fluids, and energy are divided as evenly as possible among targets that can accept them, beginning at a rotating cursor. Pipe and node budgets may spread one batch across several ticks; cursor rotation provides long-term fairness.

Extraction views all targets as one endpoint and does not enforce equal shares. The distributor has no hidden inventory. Only Sky Logistics simple pipes and logistics nodes recognize it; vanilla hoppers and third-party pipes do not connect.
Available early at a crafting table: use 4 ordinary stone blocks, 2 Redstone Dust, 2 Amethyst Shards, and 1 wooden Chest. No altar, Eulogia Crystal, or Celestial Stone is required.

Performance: placement runs one BFS and caches three target lists. Simulation builds a transfer plan that execution reuses. Internal probes obey [distributor].opsPerTick; after exhaustion the line resumes from its cursor next tick.

Hold a Celestial Configurator and aim at the distributor to outline every target in its current cache in cyan. The client requests a snapshot only when the aimed distributor changes or once per second while aiming; it never triggers BFS every frame.
